news.title: Fifa reportedly allowed DR Congo into World Cup despite ineligible player in qualifying
news.lede: Nigeria filed complaint over ineligible players in playoff. Fifa investigators aware of situation before tournament. Fifa allowed the Democratic Republic of the Congo to compete at this summer’s World Cup despite reports suggesting an internal investigation found that the country had fielded an ineligible player in qualifying. The player in question, the goalkeeper Lionel Mpasi, starred for his nation at the tournament, including against England in the last 32.

news.title: World Cup veterans named in Panama squad to face Football Ferns
news.lede: Panama have named a 23-player squad containing 15 FIFA Women’s World Cup veterans for this month’s two-match home series against the Football Ferns. Head coach María Antonia ‘Toña’ Is has selected 11 players from Panama’s domestic competition and 12 who are based overseas. Main photo: Panama coach María Antonia ‘Toña’ Is … has kept her faith in her most experienced players. Six of the overseas contingent play in Europe, providing experience as Panama prepare for a crucial FIFA Women’s World Cup qualifier against Canada next month.

news.title: Ahmad Hardy yet to return to practice for Mizzou football
news.lede: Mizzou football running back Ahmad Hardy has yet to return to practice while rehabbing a gunshot wound he sustained in May, head coach Eli Drinkwitz said Tuesday. Hardy, a consensus All-American who rushed for 1,649 yards and 16 touchdowns last year, sustained a gunshot wound at a concert in Mississippi, his home state, on May 10. Drinkwitz previously projected a two-week ramp-up period for Hardy to return to game-speed before his return. "He's doing everything he can, but we're just waiting for his body to respond," Drinkwitz said.

news.title: Former New Zealand national coaches go head-to-head in ASEAN Cup final
news.lede: Two coaches with strong ties to New Zealand football were in opposing dugouts in the final of the inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup. Former Football Ferns head coach John Herdman came out on top, with his Indonesia side beating former All Whites coach Anthony Hudson’s Thailand 4-2 on penalties in Jakarta. The teams finished 2-2 after extra time at Gelora Bung Karno Stadium, before Indonesia goalkeeper Emil Audero saved Thailand’s decisive fourth penalty. The final brought together the two coaches whose careers have included lengthy spells working within New Zealand’s national team programmes.

news.title: Where to Watch Lionel Messi’s Final Match With Argentina

An international friendly between Argentina and Benin wouldn’t necessarily be must-see TV for soccer fans, but this is no ordinary friendly: It’s Lionel Messi‘s final appearance for La Albiceleste. The match is set to be an emotional send-off for the superstar, who led his team to a World Cup and two Copa America championships after over two decades with the team. If you’re looking to stream the game in the U.S., you can watch it on ViX, a Spanish-language streaming service.

news.title: Football Australia confirms match officials for Hahn Australia Cup 2026 Final
news.lede: Football Queensland’s Faghani will be joined by assistant referees Luke Gennimatas (Football Victoria) and Claire Green (Football Tasmania), with Caitlin Williams (Football Victoria) appointed as fourth official. Shaun Evans (Football Victoria) will serve as Video Assistant Referee (VAR), supported by Maddy Allum (Football NSW) as Assistant Video Assistant Referee (AVAR). The Final will mark the first use of VAR in the Hahn Australia Cup, providing additional support to the on-field officiating team. Faghani brings extensive international experience, having refereed the 2016 Olympic Men’s Football Final, the 2018 FIFA World Cup™ third-place play-off and the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup™ Final.
